summary:
Re-verification of iteration_6's two HIGH frontend bugs. BUG #1 (Settings widget toggles) is FULLY FIXED — all 6 expected rows + checkboxes render with the correct testids, initial state matches GET /api/onboarding/state.dashboard_widgets, toggling fires PUT /api/onboarding/widgets returning 200 with widgets.reflection=false, the unchecked state persists across reload, /today hides the reflection block when off and shows it again after re-enabling. BUG #2 (Onboarding CTA occlusion by #emergent-badge) is NOT FIXED at desktop viewport (lg+): the new `pr-44 sm:pr-56` classes are overridden by `lg:px-20` because Tailwind's px-* shorthand sets BOTH paddingLeft and paddingRight at lg breakpoint. Confirmed via computed style: at 1920px footer paddingRight=80px (button right edge sits 80px from viewport right, badge is 16px from viewport right and 178px wide -> heavy overlap; elementFromPoint at button center returns the badge's

). At 768px paddingRight=224px and the button is clear. Bug #2 still blocks real desktop users from advancing the wizard with a normal (non-force) click. Backend regression: pytest test_phase6.py = 26/27 PASS; the 1 failure (TestOnboardingState.test_new_user_not_onboarded) is a stale-fixture artifact already flagged in iteration_6 (TOKEN_B was onboarded by previous run), NOT a code regression.

ui_bugs.issue:
Footer right-padding fix is INEFFECTIVE at viewport >= 1024px. Classes are `px-10 lg:px-20 py-6 pr-44 sm:pr-56`. At lg breakpoint, `lg:px-20` re-sets paddingRight to 5rem (80px), overriding `sm:pr-56` (14rem/224px) because Tailwind's `px-*` shorthand writes both PL+PR and the lg breakpoint cascades over sm. Result at 1920x1080: ob-next bounding box right edge = 80px from viewport-right; #emergent-badge bounding box right edge = 16px from viewport-right and is 178px wide → the button center (1775,1034) lies inside the badge (1726-1904, 1024-1064) and elementFromPoint returns the badge's

. Real desktop users cannot click ob-next or ob-finish normally — they receive clicks on the Emergent badge instead. Works correctly at tablet (768px) where paddingRight resolves to 224px. Fix: change `lg:px-20` to `lg:pl-20 lg:pr-56` (or larger) so right padding stays >= 200px at all breakpoints; or move the CTA out of the bottom-right column entirely.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete the wizard at 1920px without force-clicks because ob-next is occluded at step 0 by the Emergent badge. Verified the API path itself remains intact — at 768px the same flow would proceed (confirmed btn_contains_el=true at sm). POST /api/onboarding/complete behavior was previously verified 200 in iteration_6 and is unchanged.

issues: Replace `lg:px-20` with split `lg:pl-20 lg:pr-56` (or pr-60) so the CTA column never overlaps the fixed #emergent-badge at large viewports. Current fix only protects sm/md.

action_items: Update /app/frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.jsx footer classes: replace `px-10 lg:px-20 py-6 pr-44 sm:pr-56` with `pl-10 lg:pl-20 py-6 pr-44 sm:pr-56 lg:pr-60` (or equivalent split-axis padding) so the right padding at lg+ is NOT clobbered by the px shorthand. Verify ob-next is clickable without force=true at 1920x1080.

(Optional, test hygiene) Make TestOnboardingState.test_new_user_not_onboarded re-seed a fresh USER_B inside the test instead of relying on the conftest-supplied token that gets mutated by other tests.

rca of the issue: BUG #2 root cause: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.jsx (line 264), the footer className is `px-10 lg:px-20 py-6 pr-44 sm:pr-56 flex justify-between items-center border-t`. Tailwind's `px-*` is a shorthand that emits BOTH `padding-left` AND `padding-right`. At viewport >= 1024px (lg), `lg:px-20` therefore sets paddingRight back to 5rem (80px), overriding the earlier `sm:pr-56` (14rem) because the lg breakpoint's selector has the same specificity but later/larger min-width in Tailwind's stylesheet so it cascades on top of sm. The fixed Emergent badge is positioned at right:16px with width≈178px; the CTA button is right-justified inside a footer with only 80px right padding, so the button (rect right ≈ x=1840 in a 1920px viewport) lies underneath the badge (rect 1726-1904). Mitigation: replace `lg:px-20` with two separate axes — `lg:pl-20 lg:pr-60` (or `lg:pr-56` if you trust the badge stays <=14rem). After patch, verify via document.elementFromPoint(btn.cx, btn.cy) === btn (or .contains(...)) at 1920x1080.
